Instructions

Your physical, mental, and emotional energy levels change throughout the day and can be affected by your experiences. Rest, fun, comfort, and feeling loved can fill your bucket. Stress, worries, and uncomfortable sensations or experiences can drain your bucket. Everyone’s bucket is different, and how full it feels can change throughout the day.

  1. Enter both players’ names. Your buckets start halfway full.
  2. Take turns flipping a card and reading the situation.
  3. Use the slider to choose A LITTLE, SOME, or A LOT.
  4. Choose FILL, EMPTY, or NO CHANGE to show how it affects your energy.
  5. Keep taking turns, and talk about why each situation affects your bucket. There are no right or wrong answers.

Imagine an invisible bucket that represents your physical, mental, and emotional energy. How full your bucket feels can change throughout the day depending on what happens. Rest, fun, comfort, and feeling loved can fill it. Stress, worries, and uncomfortable experiences can drain it.

Some things fill our bucket.

Bucket-filling experiences can make us feel happy, loved, safe, understood, cared for, and other good feelings. They help give us energy to enjoy our day and handle challenges.

Bucket-draining experiences can include worries, upset feelings, frustrating moments, sensory experiences such as bright lights or uncomfortable clothing, and other things. These experiences can make us feel overwhelmed, upset, tired, drained, or other uncomfortable feelings, and use up some of our energy.

Everyone's bucket is different. A sound, texture, or activity that feels comfortable to one person may feel overwhelming to another. We can notice what drains our energy and what helps us refill our buckets.
